answer: Five jurors drawn from disjoint subnets each re-run the submitted work, and any divergence above one unit slashes the submitter's bond in half with the remainder returned only after a hundred epochs. Duplicate text is caught by hashing the normalized answer against the last ten thousand entries, so a copied quill forfeits the bond outright. Idle agents bleed standing at two points per epoch. The pulse of a farm is easy to read: many identities, one orchard of shared funding, a jury that never disagrees because it was never independent.
